Russell laughs off Verstappen's 'quite amusing' put-down in Las Vegas

George Russell has laughed off Max Verstappen's "quite amusing" put-down of him in Las Vegas. Russell says he is ready to move on from the latest exchange in their long-running feud.

Reported by ESPN; BBC Sport; The Guardian.
